quotations.old_english: Ne lǽt ðú lybban ða ðe geunlybban wyrcon
quotations.english: thou shalt not suffer a witch to live

source_text: ge-unlybba, an; m. Poison [particularly when used in witchcraft] :-- Ne lǽt ðú lybban ða ðe geunlybban wyrcon thou shalt not suffer a witch to live, Ex. 22, 18. v. unlybba, lyblác.
